summary.text: Dan Norton is the Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 123 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having defeated Dan Livingston in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary. He is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Norton earned a high school diploma from Maine-Endwell Senior High School, a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York at Albany and a law degree from Cornell Law School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Broome County resident who was raised in Endwell, and said he comes from a union family.
Norton named housing, affordability and infrastructure as his three key campaign messages in the survey.
He said he has worked with Broome County Habitat for Humanity to build and renovate homes.
